title.narrative: Scaling Up of Small Hydro Power (SHP) for Augmenting Rural Electricity Access - Nigeria

description.narrative: To project aims to promote investments in SHP technology and strengthen local manufacturing of SHP turbines in Nigeria. This project component will mainly strengthen the capacities of the existing SHP Technology Centre for a more effective technical support on SHP project development; facilitate both human and institutional capacity building at various levels. Training will be a major activity in this component, various stakeholders such as: mini-grid experts, policy makers, project developers, private investors, relevant institutions, engineers and financial institutions will be trained in project development and implementation of SHP projects. Efforts will be made to ensure that at least 20 % of the participants at each level are women
